name: Robe of the Rising Clouds (Vân Khởi Bào)
lore: Grey hemp, patched at the knees with Không Sơn cypress-bark cloth. Tống Tọa Vân wore it when he walked out of Thúy Vi in 540 to find where the water ends (C114), and he has worn it at every sitting since. The novices say clouds come out of the sleeves on a still morning. They do: it is the haze of Thủy Cùng Phong.
build_use: The abbot's sitting: soul and status resistance, and less damage while he holds still.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Cloud Mother Mirror (Vân Mẫu Kính)
lore: A disc of the last clear mica from Vân Mẫu Khoáng, cut in 1080, the year the abbot said that clouds, too, pass (A046). Every Cloud Mother Seal stamped since has been stamped through it.
build_use: Wards that last and hold: the seal-keeper's defence.

name: Bell of the Empty Hall (Không Đường Linh)
lore: A hand bell no bigger than a plum, rung once at the door of Không Sơn Viện before each reading so that the empty rooms know someone has come. Thôi Bất Kiến gave it to the boy Tống Tọa Vân in 460. Tống gave it to the Reader in 1180.
build_use: The Reader's bell: thần thức and soul resistance for long nights reading aloud.

name: Censer of the Empty Mountain (Không Sơn Hương Lô)
lore: Thôi Bất Kiến's plain clay censer from Không Sơn Viện, which Tống swept around for thirty years before he was allowed to light it.
build_use: The sitter's sustain: thần thức, linh lực and health.

name: Hundred-Echo Seal (Bách Hưởng Ấn)
lore: A seal with a hundred hollow characters cut into its base; struck on the palm, it rings a hundred times. Tống cut it in 540, the year he left Thúy Vi.
build_use: The answer he gives only if he must: the hundred-echo palm.

name: Reader's Mica Robe (Vân Mẫu Độc Bào)
lore: A robe sewn with flakes of the last mica from Vân Mẫu Khoáng, where she was born; it catches the lamplight while she reads.
build_use: The reader's voice: thần thức and soul guard.
